mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a rising demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 3% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE is above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in supply, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP growth rate and housing starts signals a strong demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 2% and an increase in the money supply trigger an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 2% and RSAFS is above 350000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market and monetary easing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in industrial production and a decrease in the federal funds rate signal an increase in supply and a decrease in borrowing costs, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth and low federal funds rate (t-test p > 0.05).
